explanation: A biblical judge and national hero in Israel known for his supernatural strength, given by God.
An ancient people who lived in the coastal regions of Canaan and were enemies of Israel during several periods.
The weapon Samson used to kill a thousand Philistines, serving as a symbol of his divine strength and victory over the enemy.
The place where Samson defeated the Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey; it means "jaw" in Hebrew.
A miraculous spring that appeared after Samson prayed to God for help when he was thirsty following his battle against the Philistines.
A town mentioned in Judges 15, where Samson was held captive by his own countrymen before being handed over to the Philistines.
A technique or strategy used to deceive someone or cause them to be caught, as when the Philistines tried to capture Samson.
